ha_layers_body.en:
L1 Transcribe — Local speech-to-text with basic repetition and filler cleanup.
L2 Reconstruct — Rewrites the transcript using your chosen tone.
L3 Profile — Adds your vocabulary and confirmed corrections.
L4 Advanced — Adds speech context, uncertainty signals, and user-approved Pause Bridge suggestions. It does not diagnose speech or recover words that were never spoken.
ASR heard: "So uh basically the the thing is um working"
L1: "So basically the thing is working"
L2: "The thing is working."
ha_layers_body.ru:
L1 Транскрипция \u2014 Только Whisper. Сырой текст, без ИИ-обработки. Самый быстрый.
L2 Реконструкция \u2014 GPT переписывает в вашем тоне. Убирает паразиты, исправляет грамматику. На ~1-2с медленнее.
L3 Профиль \u2014 L2 + ваш личный словарь и карта коррекций.
L4 Заикание \u2014 Клинический режим. Отслеживание дисфлюенций, оценка экспозиции, масштабированные правки.
Вы говорите: "Ну э-э в общем-то это это вещь э-э работает"
L1: "Ну э-э в общем-то это это вещь э-э работает"
L2: "Эта вещь работает."
ha_layers_body.es:
L1 Transcribir — Conversión de voz a texto local con repetición básica y limpieza de relleno.
L2 Reconstruir — Reescribe la transcripción usando el tono elegido.
Perfil L3 — Agrega su vocabulario y correcciones confirmadas.
L4 Avanzado — Agrega contexto de voz, señales de incertidumbre y sugerencias Pause Bridge aprobadas por el usuario. No diagnostica el habla ni recupera palabras que nunca fueron dichas.
ASR escuchó: "Así que, básicamente, la cosa es que estoy funcionando".
L1: "Básicamente la cosa está funcionando"
L2: "La cosa está funcionando".
ha_layers_body.fr:
L1 Transcription — Synthèse parole-texte locale avec répétition de base et nettoyage des éléments de remplissage.
Reconstruction L2 — Réécrit la transcription en utilisant le ton choisi.
Profil L3 — Ajoute votre vocabulaire et les corrections confirmées.
L4 Avancé — Ajoute un contexte vocal, des signaux d'incertitude et des suggestions Pause Bridge approuvées par l'utilisateur. Il ne diagnostique pas la parole et ne récupère pas les mots qui n'ont jamais été prononcés.
ASR a entendu : "Donc, en gros, le truc, ça marche"
L1 : "Donc, en gros, ça marche"
L2 : "Le truc fonctionne."

ha_tone_body.en:
Casual — Conversational. Contractions, simple words.
Professional — Business-ready. Clean, precise language.
Friend — Relaxed. Like texting a friend.
Formal — Academic/legal. No contractions, precise.

Has no effect on L1 (collapses when L1 is selected).

ha_mode_body.en:
RAW paste original — Pastes the transcription after basic cleanup.
FAST reconstruct — Pastes the rewrite immediately.
SAFE + meaning guard — Keeps the original when a rewrite drops a name, number, date, amount, or negation. This is a deterministic guard, not a second AI or a guarantee of identical meaning.

All three produce the same output on L1.

SAFE + проверка Falcon \u2014 GPT переписывает, Falcon проверяет сохранение смысла. Медленнее, но безопаснее.

Все три дают одинаковый результат на L1. Сворачивается при выборе L1.

Los tres producen el mismo resultado en L1.

ha_enhance_body.en:
Paralinguistic — Estimates cough, laugh, sigh, throat-clear, breathing, and pauses from audio signals. These are experimental labels, not diagnoses.
  • Transcribe sub-toggle: ON = tags may be inserted in text. OFF = logged only.

Prosodic — Measures pitch, energy, and speaking rate and can increase L4 assist intensity. It does not measure stuttering severity.

  \u2022 Транскрипция: ВКЛ = теги в тексте ([Смех]). ВЫКЛ = только в логе.

Просодика \u2014 Отслеживает тон (F0), энергию, темп речи. Влияет на модификатор тяжести на L4. Авто-включается на L4 и при Стрессе.
Консоль: "Речь: pause_ratio=47% rate=3.4syl/s \u2192 severity +0.4"
Консоль: "Просодика: Вокальное напряжение (хаотичный тон в 100%)"

  • Transcribir subalternancia: ON = se pueden insertar etiquetas en el texto. APAGADO = solo registrado.

prosódico — Mide el tono, la energía y la velocidad del habla y puede aumentar la intensidad de la asistencia L4. No mide la gravedad de la tartamudez.
ha_enhance_body.fr:

  • Sous-bascule de transcription : ON = des balises peuvent être insérées dans le texte. OFF = connecté uniquement.

ha_whisper_body.en:
Multi-Temp — Runs speech recognition at multiple temperatures. Agreement suggests a more stable transcription; disagreement is flagged. It is slower.
Pause suspects — Marks low-audio regions where ASR may hallucinate text. This does not detect an internal speech block or recover an unspoken word.
No Speech slider — Sensitive catches more regions; Tolerant produces fewer false alarms.
Avg LogProb — The recognizer's confidence signal.
ha_whisper_body.ru:
Мульти-Темп \u2014 Запускает Whisper при разных температурах. Совпадение = уверенность. Расхождение = флаг. В 3 раза медленнее.
Блоки \u2014 Обнаруженные блоки речи (Whisper галлюцинировал в тишине).
Ползунок тишины \u2014 \u25C4 Чувствительно (ловит больше) vs. Толерантно \u25BA (меньше ложных тревог). По умолчанию: 15%.
Ср. LogProb \u2014 Уверенность Whisper. Выше -0.4 = хорошо. Ниже -0.7 = угадывает.
ha_whisper_body.es:
Multitemperatura — Ejecuta el reconocimiento de voz a múltiples temperaturas. La concordancia sugiere una transcripción más estable; Se señala el desacuerdo. Es más lento.
Pausa sospechosos — Marca regiones con bajo nivel de audio donde ASR puede alucinar texto. Esto no detecta un bloqueo interno del habla ni recupera una palabra no dicha.
Control deslizante sin voz — Sensible captura más regiones; Tolerante produce menos falsas alarmas.
Problema de registro promedio — La señal de confianza del reconocedor.
ha_whisper_body.fr:
Multi-Temp — Exécute la reconnaissance vocale à plusieurs températures. L'accord suggère une transcription plus stable ; le désaccord est signalé. C'est plus lent.
Suspendre les suspects — Marque les régions à faible niveau audio où ASR peut halluciner du texte. Cela ne détecte pas un blocage de parole interne ni ne récupère un mot non prononcé.
Aucun curseur de parole — Les captures sensibles dans plus de régions ; Tolerant produit moins de fausses alarmes.
Prob de journal moyen — Le signal de confiance du reconnaisseur.
ha_whisper_body.de:
[de] Multi-Temp \u2014 Runs Whisper at multiple temperatures. Agreement = confident. Disagreement = flagged. 3x slower.
Blocks \u2014 Speech blocks detected (Whisper hallucinated over silence).
No Speech slider \u2014 \u25C4 Sensitive (catches more) vs. Tolerant \u25BA (fewer false alarms). Default: 15%.
Avg LogProb \u2014 Whisper confidence. Above -0.4 = good. Below -0.7 = guessing.

ha_pipeline_body.en:
1. Record
Hold F9, or click once to start and again to stop. You control when listening ends.

2. Transcribe
Local faster-whisper is the default. Cloud transcription runs only when selected and configured. Script Prep can give the recognizer expected wording.

3. Clean
Rules remove recognizable fillers, repetitions, and common ASR artifacts. Lavrentiy can only work from captured audio and ASR text; silence does not reveal a missing word.

4. Reconstruct
L2 applies tone, L3 adds confirmed personal vocabulary, and L4 adds uncertainty and speech context. Pause Bridge may offer optional completions from the words already captured; the user chooses whether to use one.

5. Guard
SAFE mode keeps the original when a rewrite drops a name, number, date, amount, or negation. It is not a guarantee of identical meaning.

6. Paste
The chosen text is copied and pasted into the active Windows app.

faster-whisper local es el valor predeterminado. La transcripción en la nube se ejecuta solo cuando se selecciona y configura. Script Prep puede proporcionarle al reconocedor la redacción esperada.

3. Limpiar
Las reglas eliminan rellenos, repeticiones y artefactos comunes de ASR reconocibles. Lavrentiy solo puede funcionar a partir de audio capturado y texto ASR; El silencio no revela una palabra faltante.

4. Reconstruir
L2 aplica tono, L3 agrega vocabulario personal confirmado y L4 agrega incertidumbre y contexto del habla. Pause Bridge puede ofrecer completaciones opcionales a partir de las palabras ya capturadas; el usuario elige si desea utilizar uno.

5. Guardia
El modo SAFE mantiene el original cuando una reescritura elimina un nombre, número, fecha, cantidad o negación. No es una garantía de significado idéntico.

6. Pegar
El texto elegido se copia y pega en la aplicación activa de Windows.

ha_pipeline_body.de:
[de] 1. You speak
Your voice is captured through the microphone. The audio is cleaned up (background noise removed, volume leveled) before anything else touches it.

2. Whisper listens
OpenAI\u2019s Whisper converts your speech to text. It also reports how confident it is about each word. Quiet moments (blocks, pauses) are flagged rather than guessed at.
If you use Script Prep, your intended text helps Whisper guess better \u2014 like giving it the answer key.

3. Quick cleanup
Before any AI gets involved, obvious disfluencies are stripped automatically (zero cost, instant):
• Repeated syllables: \u201cp-p-pop\u201d \u2192 \u201cpop\u201d
• Repeated words: \u201cI I I want\u201d \u2192 \u201cI want\u201d
• Fillers: \u201cum\u201d, \u201cuh\u201d, \u201clike\u201d, \u201cyou know\u201d
• False starts: \u201cgoing to\u2014 I went\u201d \u2192 \u201cI went\u201d
• Prolongations: \u201cmmmmaybe\u201d \u2192 \u201cmaybe\u201d
Natural phrases like \u201cbye bye\u201d and \u201chad had\u201d are kept \u2014 real grammar, not disfluencies.

4. Depends on your Layer:

Layer 1 \u2014 Done. The cleaned text is pasted. No AI, no cost beyond transcription.

Layer 2 \u2014 GPT rewrites using your chosen tone (casual, professional, etc). It knows the text came from a microphone, so it\u2019s forgiving about messiness. No personal data used.

Layer 3 \u2014 Same as L2, plus GPT knows your preferred words and learned corrections.

Layer 4 \u2014 The full engine. A stronger AI model gets a detailed briefing:
• Which sounds are hardest for you
• Words you tend to avoid and swap
• Where Whisper was uncertain or detected a block
• Non-verbal events (coughs, pauses) so it doesn\u2019t make up words
• Your pitch, energy, and speaking rate patterns

5. Safety check
In SAFE mode, a second AI reads both your original words and the rewrite, and asks: \u201cDid the meaning change?\u201d If yes, the rewrite is rejected and your original text is used. Numbers, dollar amounts, and percentages are double-checked separately.

6. Paste
The final text goes to your clipboard and is pasted into whatever app you\u2019re using.

2. Whisper listens
OpenAI\u2019s Whisper converts your speech to text. It also reports how confident it is about each word. Quiet moments (blocks, pauses) are flagged rather than guessed at.
If you use Script Prep, your intended text helps Whisper guess better \u2014 like giving it the answer key.

3. Quick cleanup
Before any AI gets involved, obvious disfluencies are stripped automatically (zero cost, instant):
• Repeated syllables: \u201cp-p-pop\u201d \u2192 \u201cpop\u201d
• Repeated words: \u201cI I I want\u201d \u2192 \u201cI want\u201d
• Fillers: \u201cum\u201d, \u201cuh\u201d, \u201clike\u201d, \u201cyou know\u201d
• False starts: \u201cgoing to\u2014 I went\u201d \u2192 \u201cI went\u201d
• Prolongations: \u201cmmmmaybe\u201d \u2192 \u201cmaybe\u201d
Natural phrases like \u201cbye bye\u201d and \u201chad had\u201d are kept \u2014 real grammar, not disfluencies.

4. Depends on your Layer:

Layer 1 \u2014 Done. The cleaned text is pasted. No AI, no cost beyond transcription.

Layer 2 \u2014 GPT rewrites using your chosen tone (casual, professional, etc). It knows the text came from a microphone, so it\u2019s forgiving about messiness. No personal data used.

Layer 3 \u2014 Same as L2, plus GPT knows your preferred words and learned corrections.

Layer 4 \u2014 The full engine. A stronger AI model gets a detailed briefing:
• Which sounds are hardest for you
• Words you tend to avoid and swap
• Where Whisper was uncertain or detected a block
• Non-verbal events (coughs, pauses) so it doesn\u2019t make up words
• Your pitch, energy, and speaking rate patterns

5. Safety check
In SAFE mode, a second AI reads both your original words and the rewrite, and asks: \u201cDid the meaning change?\u201d If yes, the rewrite is rejected and your original text is used. Numbers, dollar amounts, and percentages are double-checked separately.

6. Paste
The final text goes to your clipboard and is pasted into whatever app you\u2019re using.

• Click the timer in the status ring to reset it.
• Compact toggle (top-left) collapses to a minimal bar with clickable chips.
• Tone and Mode auto-collapse on L1 (they have no effect).

• Click any stat/learn bar cell to jump to its detail tab.
